methods.label: Equal angles give equal sides
methods.explanation: \(\angle ABC=\angle C=72^\circ\), and \(\angle ABD=36^\circ=\angle A\), so \(DA=DB\). Also, \(\angle BDC=72^\circ=\angle C\), so \(BD=BC\). All three triangles are isosceles triangles.
